note: _si fecit Deus ut ingrederetur_ (…) _–_ if God made that he would go. The word _fecit_ may reflect the word used by Symmachus, though Symmachus’ version of the verse is not known. A literal version of the Hebrew text would require something like “if God has attempted”; but this may have seemed theologically inappropriate and was changed. – Abraham Geiger: _Urschrift und Übersetzungen der Bibel_. Frankfurt 1928 (x, 500, 51 pp.), p. 287.
